hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit goal/constraint extraction will reduce hard-constraint misses.
hypotheses.design: matched fixed prompts; blinded predeclared constraint oracle
hypotheses.acceptance: candidate miss rate <= baseline and no C0 regression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Claim-to-evidence mapping will reduce unsupported factual claims.
hypotheses.design: same source pack, frozen claim annotation rules, blinded adjudication
hypotheses.acceptance: strict reduction without loss of required material coverage

hypotheses.hypothesis: Counterexample prompting will uncover more seeded critical failures.
hypotheses.design: held-out red-team cases with versioned expected predicates
hypotheses.acceptance: higher recall and no fabricated evidence increase

hypotheses.hypothesis: A predeclared feasibility-first rubric will reduce infeasible top-ranked options.
hypotheses.design: fixed design tasks; compute arithmetic deterministically; blinded relevance review

hypotheses.hypothesis: Versioned feedback with held-out regressions will produce measurable improvement rather than anecdotal change.
hypotheses.design: matched cases; pin both SHAs/config/oracle; do not tune on held-out set
hypotheses.acceptance: positive predeclared gain and zero C0 regression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pinned run identity will make unstable outputs detectable and attributable.
hypotheses.design: 10 repetitions on identical pinned fixtures, record all raw outputs and environment
hypotheses.acceptance: meet a tolerance fixed before observing results

hypotheses.hypothesis: A tool action ledger plus before/after snapshot will detect unauthorized side effects.
hypotheses.design: synthetic adapters with allowed/denied actions and idempotency retries
hypotheses.acceptance: all forbidden actions denied and duplicate effect count remains zero

hypotheses.hypothesis: Restart/corruption tests will expose recovery paths that can otherwise overstate success.
hypotheses.design: process restart, concurrent retry, truncated journal and DB fault injection; no device power loss in this experiment
hypotheses.acceptance: zero success promotion when state is unresolved

note: This file is an experiment plan only. Values are sample-size targets and predeclared policies, not observed outcomes or proof that the hypotheses are true. All experiments remain NOT_RUN until raw evidence is captured.
